entries.rootCause: GitHub runner could not reach dtfseeds.com and failed with ETIMEDOUT/ENETUNREACH before product verification executed.
successfulRepairs: Retry the exact verifier after network recovery; do not change unrelated product code solely to clear a runner connectivity failure.
invalidatedWorkarounds: Editing THC RPG code without evidence of a product defect.

entries.rootCause: An otherwise green Project OS PR diverged from main and overlapped a deployment workflow, causing GitHub to reject the merge as not mergeable.
successfulRepairs: Replay the coherent infrastructure slice on current main, preserve newer workflow changes, and exclude colliding queue mutations.
invalidatedWorkarounds: Force-merging or overwriting current production workflow state.
